description: This Java class is a command handler for creating fixed deposit products in the Fineract microfinance platform. It implements the NewCommandSourceHandler interface and delegates the create operation to the FixedDepositProductWritePlatformService.

classes.name: CreateFixedDepositProductCommandHandler
classes.description: A Spring service class that handles the creation of fixed deposit products by processing commands and delegating to the write platform service.

methods.name: CreateFixedDepositProductCommandHandler
methods.description: Constructor which autowires the FixedDepositProductWritePlatformService dependency.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes the incoming JsonCommand to create a fixed deposit product via the write platform service.
